charge_port.notes: CCS1 (J1772 native inlet) through the 2026 model year: GM WT spec guide lists the NACS DC adapter as intended for a J1772 native inlet vehicle (US spec guide, 2025/2026). Same port assumed for the Canadian car (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter). Model year 2025.

supercharger_access.notes: Canadian article (2024-09-18): Canadian Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ owners can buy the GM NACS adapter for Tesla Superchargers. Current state for model year 2025: adapter needed. Markets: CA.

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(19.2 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time. NRCan 2025 lists only "LT/RST Ext Range (19.2 kW Charger)" for this variant; the powertrain value of 11.5 kW is wrong for it.
